score_scale.1: Poor: absent, seriously flawed, or unsupported.
score_scale.2: Weak: material gaps substantially limit confidence.
score_scale.3: Adequate: acceptable coverage with notable limitations.
score_scale.4: Strong: well supported with only minor limitations.
score_scale.5: Exceptional: unusually complete, rigorous, and well supported.

dimensions.research_question_clarity: Research problem, objectives, scope, and motivation are explicit; writing style alone is not rewarded.
dimensions.methodological_rigor: The method is technically sound, justified, internally consistent, and sufficiently detailed.
dimensions.experimental_design: Datasets, protocols, controls, metrics, sample sizes, and ablations answer the research question.
dimensions.baseline_quality: Relevant competitive baselines are included and compared under reasonably fair conditions.
dimensions.result_validity: Conclusions follow from results, uncertainty and negative findings are handled, and claims are proportionate.
dimensions.reproducibility: Model versions, data, parameters, training details, implementation, and evaluation procedures are documented.
dimensions.novelty: The contribution is clearly differentiated from relevant prior work.
dimensions.limitations_discussion: Assumptions, failure cases, generalisation limits, ethical concerns, and unresolved questions are acknowledged.
dimensions.citation_quality: Important claims are connected to relevant prior work with balanced coverage; citation count alone is not rewarded.
